Do you enjoy active work and like staying busy? As an Order Picker, you collect orders in the warehouse and make sure everything is complete and ready for shipment. 
 Over het werk 
As an Order Picker, you drive through the warehouse using an electric order picking truck. With a hand scanner, you can see which products you need to collect and where to find them. 
You will work with products such as toilets and bathtubs. Some items can be heavier. If something is too heavy to lift alone, you will do this together with a colleague. 
You may also occasionally help with checking orders or support the expedition department. 
 Wat wij bieden 
 - Work in a two-shift system - A buddy who will help train you - Varied warehouse work - A job within a growing company - Salary and shift allowance according to the applicable agreements 
 Wat wij vragen 
 - You speak Dutch or English - You are able to perform physical work - You are available to work in a two-shift system - You are open to occasional night- and weekend shifts - You work accurately 
 Over het bedrijf 
You will work at a company that has been in business for more than 100 years and is active in the sanitary ware industry. Around 50 employees work at this location. 
The company has a friendly and informal working atmosphere. Communication lines are short and the manager is regularly present on the work floor. Many employees have been working there for a long time and both Dutch and English are spoken within the company. The company expects to continue growing in the coming years.
